note: Measured on the oldest 30 held-out Django fixes with claude-sonnet-5-5. Token, turn and file numbers are means per issue. Accuracy is about the same with and without the tool (top-1 function 0.43 vs 0.40, one issue). The tool cut input tokens by 16 percent, or 27 percent when the agent is told to call it first.

tool_calls.name: locate_bug
tool_calls.result_summary: Top hits were GeneratedField.__init__ and GeneratedField._check_supported, via a past fix (#36262) and a CALLS edge. The agent then read the PostgreSQL backend and named DatabaseFeatures.is_postgresql_18, the gold function. Without the tool it named a schema editor method and missed.
